name: H. R. Lyon
role: Mandan man favored for the legislature in 1886
bio: H. R. Lyon of Mandan was the Cow Boy's preferred candidate for the legislature in August and September 1886, and the delegates from its area favored him. In October 1886 Mitchell of Mandan won the Morton County delegates after a sharp contest, but the paper said the legislative nomination was still open between the two.
